plan.reason: With 24 of 100 evaluations used and stagnation at 9 with zero recent improvement, the current plan is likely over-exploiting. Increasing exploration and radius encourages novelty to escape the plateau, while auto surrogate lets held-out RMSE pick RBF vs quadratic as data accumulates. current_to_best with moderate mutation/crossover balances local refinement and exploitation of the surrogate; modest population and generations keep surrogate-assisted search cheap so remaining true evaluations are spread over more iterations.

Moderate stagnation and low recent improvement with high cross-validated RMSE suggest the surrogate is still weak, so auto surrogate selection remains preferable while data accumulates. Raising exploration and keeping a non-trivial radius favors novelty to escape the plateau, while current_to_best with moderate mutation and high crossover balances surrogate-guided exploitation with local refinement. A modest population and generations keep surrogate-assisted iterations cheap so the remaining true evaluations are spread across more updates; local_fraction stays moderate to avoid over-committing to a possibly inaccurate local model.

With 64/100 evaluations used and high CV normalized RMSE (~0.40), the surrogate is unreliable; auto selection lets the held-out RMSE pick RBF vs quadratic as more points arrive. Stagnation is mild and recent improvement small, so increasing exploration to 1.1 and keeping a moderate radius pushes novelty to escape the plateau without abandoning surrogate guidance. current_to_best with moderate mutation and high crossover balances exploitation and diversity, while a slightly larger population and generations make each surrogate generation informative before spending scarce remaining true evaluations. local_fraction stays modest to avoid over-trusting a weak local model.

Only 16 true evaluations remain and recent improvement is zero with 15-step stagnation, so the priority is a diverse, novelty-seeking push rather than fine exploitation. CV RMSE ~0.30 indicates a moderately reliable surrogate, so auto keeps RBF vs quadratic selection adaptive. Raising exploration to 1.3 and shrinking radius slightly widens the search around the incumbent to escape the plateau, while low local_fraction avoids over-trusting the local model with scarce budget. current_to_best with moderate mutation and high crossover balances convergence bias with diversity across the small remaining population/generation allocation.
